items.title: Carol Bash interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2012
items.q: He’s very proud of being a Hamilton alum but he doesn’t really talk much about his college years.

ctx.x: Right, exactly. It was all just the old side of the campus. Hamilton was all men. You know, I couldn’t imagine what that would be like. This is pre-civil rights movement. You know, so honestly he’s proud of Hamilton. He’s very proud of being a Hamilton alum but he doesn’t really talk much about his college years. And I don’t know if it’s uncomfortable or if there’s some things he kind of wants to keep to himself. Maybe it was hard, I can imagine it was difficult.
Yeah, my impression of reading about those times is that Hamilton was not necessarily on the forefront of change.
